documents.t: This questionnaire is used during discovery workshops for Microsoft 365, Azure, Security, Copilot and migration engagements. The objective is to capture business context, technical environment, risks, constraints and success criteria before proposal, assessment or implementation planning. Discovery FlowWorkshop input to engagement roadmap

What is the primary business objective? What business problem are you trying to solve? Who is the executive sponsor? Which departments are impacted? What is the target timeline? Are there budget constraints? What does project success look like?

Current Microsoft 365 licenses? Total number of users? Number of frontline users? Current tenant structure? Current domain structure? Any hybrid configuration? Any third-party security or collaboration tools?

Is Microsoft Entra ID currently used? Is MFA enabled for all users? Are Conditional Access policies configured? Are guest users allowed? Are privileged roles reviewed regularly? Is PIM currently used? Are break-glass accounts configured?

Is email already on Exchange Online? Are there on-premises Exchange servers? Are shared mailboxes used? Are distribution groups used? Are SMTP relay dependencies present? Is external forwarding allowed? Are SPF, DKIM and DMARC configured?

Is Teams used as the primary collaboration platform? Who can create Teams? Is guest access enabled? Is external access enabled? Are Teams lifecycle policies defined? Are inactive Teams reviewed? Are private or shared channels used?

Is SharePoint used for document management? Are legacy file servers or NAS still used? Is external sharing enabled? Are anonymous links allowed? Are permissions reviewed regularly? Is metadata used? Is there a document lifecycle policy?

Is Microsoft Defender used? Is Defender for Endpoint deployed? Is Defender for Office 365 deployed? Is Microsoft Secure Score reviewed? Are security incidents monitored? Is there a SOC process? Are endpoint devices managed?

Is Microsoft Purview used? Are sensitivity labels deployed? Are DLP policies configured? Are retention policies configured? Are audit logs reviewed? Are there regulatory requirements? Are there data residency requirements?

Is Microsoft 365 Copilot planned? Which users are target users? Are SharePoint permissions reviewed? Are sensitive documents classified? Is there an AI governance policy? Is there a user training plan? Is there a champion program?

What is the source environment? What workloads need migration? How much data needs migration? Are there domain dependencies? Are there coexistence requirements? Are there blackout periods? Is executive user migration required?

Who operates Microsoft 365 today? Is there an internal help desk? Are standard operating procedures documented? Are change management processes defined? Are admin roles clearly assigned? Is reporting required?
Known technical risks? Known business risks? Security concerns? Compliance concerns? Timeline constraints? Resource constraints? User resistance concerns?
The questionnaire should support creation of: Discovery Summary Current State Assessment Risk Register Scope Definition SOW WBS Roadmap Executive Summary

한글 요약Microsoft 365 보안 프로젝트를 처음부터 보고서까지 한 흐름으로 관리하는 포털입니다. 파일은 공개하지 않으며, 설계 내용과 적용 방법은 브리핑으로 안내합니다.

실제 Microsoft 365 보안 프로젝트를 진행하며 만든 작업 도구입니다. 조사에서 보고까지 흩어지기 쉬운 산출물을 한 화면에서 이어 갑니다. 영역 내용 플랜 비교 Business Basic부터 E7까지 보안 기능 범위를 비교합니다. Copilot 도입 판단 정보보호 요청사항별로 도입 가능 여부와 조건을 정리합니다. 보안 아키텍처 플랜과 구성요소를 고르면 데이터 흐름도가 바뀝니다. 고객 환경 조사·요구사항·인터뷰 조사 항목과 인터뷰 기록을 요구사항으로 연결합니다. 정책 설계·작업 절차서 조건부 액세스, DLP, 레이블 등 정책 초안과 적용 절차를 작성합니다. WBS·진행 현황 예정 공정표와 결정 사항을 관리합니다. 보고서 정의한 내용을 경영진 보고용 PPT와 문서로 정리합니다.

금융권·대기업 환경에서 보안 요구사항을 정책과 공정표로 바꾸는 순서 Copilot 도입 판단표를 정보보호 조직과 함께 쓰는 방법 플랜 선택에 따라 달라지는 보안 아키텍처와 데이터 흐름 프로젝트 단계별 산출물과 경영진 보고 구성 조직 환경에 맞춘 포털 구성과 적용 범위 :::note 파일은 공개하지 않습니다 포털 파일과 설계서 원본은 공개 다운로드로 제공하지 않습니다. 프로젝트 상황을 듣고 필요한 범위에 맞춰 브리핑과 적용 방법을 안내합니다. :::

아래 내용을 함께 보내 주시면 브리핑 범위를 빠르게 정할 수 있습니다. 첫 연락에는 고객사 이름이나 내부 정보를 넣지 않아도 됩니다. 업종과 대략적인 사용자 규모 사용 중이거나 검토 중인 Microsoft 365 플랜 프로젝트 단계(검토, 설계, 구축, 운영) 가장 궁금한 주제(예: Copilot 도입 판단, 조건부 액세스, DLP, 보고서 구성) LinkedIn으로 브리핑 요청 문의 방법 보기
